text: Ever lost track of a pull request that was waiting on you? StaleMate helps with that. It shows every open pull request on the team, whose turn it is, and how long it has been waiting. You can find it at stalemate.mapcolonies.net.

say: First, tell StaleMate who you are. Open "I am" at the top, and pick your name. Here, I'm Mergey Mick-Merge-face, and now the "Your turn" tab shows how many pull requests are waiting on you.

text: In the Table view, the "Your turn" tab shows the pull requests where you need to do something, like a review or a fix. "Your PRs" shows the ones you opened, and "Involving you" shows everything you are part of. You can search, filter and sort as you like.
Next is the Inbox. It puts pull requests into simple lists: your turn first, then your pull requests that wait on others, then the ones with no reviewer, and then the rest of the team.
Then there's the Board. It has a column for each person, so you can see at a glance who every pull request is waiting on. Your column is always first.

Now, notifications. When a pull request becomes your turn, the bell shows a number. Click it to see what is new. Open the pull request from here, or dismiss it when you are done. Tick "Also send them to my OS" to get a desktop pop-up too, even when the tab is in the background.
And of course, we also support dark mode.
That's it. Open StaleMate, pick yourself, and never miss a review again.
